review.summary: Functionally the connector works. The trace proves a single east-side leg (WorldCollision/AlleyPavement, X6..22, Z8..20) outside the old X-1..6 / Z-2..30 bounds: on foot 15 outside samples (~1.6s), max 6.53m beyond the boundary, physically returned inside by 15.97s; in the car 48 outside samples (~5s), max 13.77m beyond, returned inside by 33.63s — both outside visits exceed the 1s visibility minimum, no R reset occurred during either leg, and walk/world/motor/courier/failure-retry/combat regressions all pass with colliders intact; rendered support sampling is clean (188 samples, 0 uncovered). In frame-000.png (t=8.58s) the player stands in the original grey-asphalt corridor with readable HUD/controls text, but the right-side fence/bollard line reads as continuous with no legible opening at Z8..20. In frame-001.png (t=12.90s) the walking-outside capture shows the extension as a bare flat tan slab with no walls, curbs, or props, merging into the flat backdrop horizon. In frame-005.png (t=26.85s) the driving-outside capture shows the same unbounded tan plane under the blue coupe — the junction is not understandable from inside and the surface material does not match the corridor asphalt. In frame-008.png (t=35.00s) the return capture shows the car stopped nose-against the corridor fence/dumpster under the MISSION FAILED screen (timeout, no reset). Core/camera/missions/assets/controls are preserved per the regression set. The scoped foundation logic passes; the presentation half of the scope (coherent visible pavement, understandable junction) needs the fixes below.
